_note: 1_E01 — the errand-system tutorial pseudo-mission: Petey in the boys' dorm asks the player to carry a parcel to Beatrice waiting outside (recon: docs/re-notes/ch1/1_E01-errand-tutorial.md). Not a catalog story mission; passing 1_07 force-completes it in the original (our campaign table does the same) — but it exists as a playable mission so the errand loop is real once. v1 simplifications: the tutorial cards are the speech/hint beats; the accept/deliver pair-anims are stubs; the 'left the dorm early' fail is skipped (1_E01 has no DAT, so there is no trigger file to build the dorm's area box from — leave_area has nothing to read); the clock pauses for the errand like the original and unpauses on delivery. The door unlock (DT_DormExitDoorL) is skipped. Coordinates are the recon's raw literals (no DAT exists). Pass pays $5 via the campaign on_pass (errand completion 500). Wording is original.
title: Petey's Errand
